mintAuthority.summary: siUSD is an immutable ERC-4626 staking vault over iUSD. Share creation occurs only against deposited iUSD through ERC4626 deposit/mint, with no privileged arbitrary share-minter or proxy upgrade on the token itself. Core FINANCE_MANAGER (YieldSharing proxy) can deposit rewards, toggle the entry/exit gate, and slash vault-held iUSD via applyLosses(), while Core GOVERNOR (7-day Timelock proposed by the 4-of-7 admin Safe) can re-point yieldSharing and upgrade YieldSharing. Durable parent iUSD issuance remains inherited from iusd-infinifi.
mintAuthority.headline: Deposits back immutable siUSD shares; YieldSharing controls slashing and entry gating, while iUSD issuance stays upstream.

capSemanticsReview.rationale: At finalized Ethereum block 26506658 (hash 0x2b69b7934b1e88fb42e9f10e6d0bff1f9114b5f1334c87ee41cc2aa8c9210f31), verified immutable StakedToken 0xdbdc1ef57537e34680b898e1febd3d68c7389bcb mints siUSD shares solely through OpenZeppelin ERC4626._deposit after transferring canonical iUSD from the caller. No privileged share-mint entrypoint or proxy upgrade exists on StakedToken. FINANCE_MANAGER can transfer iUSD into the vault via depositRewards() or burn vault iUSD via applyLosses(), changing exchange rate rather than minting unbacked siUSD shares. Parent iUSD unbounded issuance is carried by the serial-claim dependency on iusd-infinifi.
